name: Ainzón (Spain)
description: White field with blue wavy stripes along the upper and lower edges, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Ainzón (stars on blue within a border inscribed with the town's title).
history: Municipal flag of Ainzón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
